verdict.rationale: Reclaim's Scheduling Links let others book against "you and your team's availability" across many calendars, but nothing in the evidence describes round-robin distribution of inbound meetings among team members. Its P1–P4 priority levels control how events are scheduled on one person's own calendar, not how bookings are weighted across hosts, so they are an adjacent feature, not fair-load distribution.

support.subject: As a sales lead, inbound meetings distribute across my team round-robin, with weighting or priority so load stays fair
